Arcane Denial/counter-target-spell: The counter DESTINATIONS are correct (Arcane Denial to p0's graveyard, the countered Lightning Bolt to p1's graveyard; CR 701.5a) -- the round-1 defect row that claimed the countered spells move into the OPPOSING player's hand was withdrawn after a probe. The real divergence is delayed-trigger timing: at the counter's resolution, before any upkeep, p1 (the countered spell's controller) has ALREADY drawn a card (p1 hand [Wastes]; one Draw event for p1 in the counter's resolve), while CR 610.2 puts both draws at the beginning of the NEXT turn's upkeep. p0's hand 1 here is his own uncast Lightning Bolt -- the scenario's hand_size wants are CR-correct (p0 1, p1 0).
Arcane Denial/next-upkeep-denied-players: At p1's (the countered spell's controller's) upkeep the draw-up-to-two fired for the WRONG seat: p0 (the caster) drew 2 Wastes (p0 hand [Lightning Bolt, Wastes, Wastes]) while p1's 'may draw up to two' ask was never posed (p1 stayed at the 1 Wastes spuriously drawn at counter time, the sibling scenario's divergence) and the runner's trigger_optional/choose answers went unconsumed. This is rules/mordorparams_test.go's documented gap: SP$ Counter's RememberTargets$ True is unread (the paramcensus row param:api:Counter.RememberTargets), so DelayTriggerRemembered is empty and the Draw retargets at the resolving source's controller; TestArcaneDenialSlowtripDrawsUpToTwo pins the primitive working when the remembered player IS delivered.
